title: picturing-fb-reals: code for "A Fatou-Bieberbach Definition of the Reals That Does Not Come from Exponential Quotients"
description: Code to generate the figures and check the numerical claims of the paper "A Fatou-Bieberbach Definition of the Reals That Does Not Come from Exponential Quotients" by Matthew Frank, about the entire function f with f(x,y) = f(4x,4y)/4 + f(2y,2x)^2 and the set S = {f(x,y) : f(2y,2x) = 0}.
